title: QC Inspection — Get a QC Inspection Quote via ICW
purpose: Ask ICW to quote and arrange a third-party QC inspection for your products.
meta: https://qmas.icw.io/inspection → **Create Job** → **Get QC inspection quote via ICW**
1 Inspection Requirement → 2 Report Details → 3 Supplier & Factory → 4 Additional Information → 5 Review & Submit
overview: Open **QC Inspection**, click **Create Job**, choose **Get QC inspection quote via ICW** and click **Continue**.
**Inspection Requirement**: date, type, level, AQL, budget and provider preference.
**Report Details**: products and POs to inspect.
**Supplier & Factory**: who makes the goods and where the inspection takes place.

body: In the left menu, open **QC Inspection**. The charts show inspection results, service providers and job types. Tabs list **All Job**, **3rd Party Job**, **Inhouse Record** and **Draft**. Click **Create Job**.

body.caption: QC Inspection list with Create Job.

steps.h: 2. Choose what you are looking for

table: Get QC inspection quote via ICW
You want ICW to arrange a third-party inspector. This guide.
Your own QC team will inspect. See the Internal QC Inspection guide.
The inspection is already done and you want to record the result.

body: Choose **Get QC inspection quote via ICW** and click **Continue**.

list: **Inspection type**: Final Random, Loading, During Production, Re-Inspection, Initial Production, Fabric, 100% or Vendor Own Inspection.
**Inspection Level**: General Inspection Level I–III or Special Level S-1 to S-4.
**Inspection AQL**: Critical, Major and Minor levels. They apply to all products in this job by default.
**Target Budget** (currency and amount) and **Service Provider Preference**. Leave “No preference, ICW will match you with the best inspector” selected if you have no preferred provider.

body.caption: Step 1 filled in. Click Save to keep a draft, or Next.

body: Click **Add Product**, search for the product, click **Select**, then **Confirm**.

body.caption: Select related product(s) — search by name, item no., supplier or factory.

body: For each product, fill in the **PO** details: customer name, customer PO #, PO #, order quantity and number of cartons. Use **Add New PO** for more POs, **Add Product** for more products, and **Add Report** or **Duplicate Report** if you need separate reports. Tick **Signed Sample Available** if there is one. Click **Next**.

body.caption: Report 1 with one product and its PO.

body: Click **Add Supplier** and select the supplier. Then click **Select Existing Factory** and choose the factory where the inspection will take place. Check the contact person, phone and email for each. Click **Next**.

body.caption: Supplier and factory selected, with contact details.

body: Upload reference files such as tech packs or previous reports, and write any special requirement in **Remark**. Click **Next**.
Check the summary. Click **Edit** on any section to change it. Click **Submit**.
QMAS shows “Create job successfully!” and opens the job. It has a Job ID and starts as **Under Review**. The **Quotes**, **Reports**, **Attachments** and **Invoices** tabs follow the job.

tips: Click **Save** on any step to keep a draft. Drafts are on the **Draft** tab.
Submit well before the inspection date so there is time for quoting and booking.
faq: How do I book a third-party QC inspection?
Go to QC Inspection (https://qmas.icw.io/inspection), click Create Job, choose Get QC inspection quote via ICW, then complete the 5 steps and Submit.
What is the difference between a QC inspection quote and an internal inspection?
A quote via ICW uses a third-party inspector arranged by ICW. An internal inspection is done by your own QC team (Internal QC Inspection).
Can I save a QC job and finish it later?
Yes. Click Save on any step. The job is kept on the Draft tab.
